correctness.rationale: Exact Laplacian pseudoinverse and transfer-current covariance produce a complete, mutually orthogonal decomposition (triangular-graph constant sector, part-specific contrasts, and edge-block tensor contrasts). Each eigenvalue, multiplicity, and strict gap is derived algebraically. Standalone checker exhaustively enumerates 384 trees of K_(2,2,2), checks 144 exact covariance entries, five numerical eigenspectra and 1606 rational parameter profiles. Finite checks support, not replace, proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Chaourar gives facets, so cannot directly imply metric covariance. The 2023/2026 counting results can recover every one-/two-edge probability and hence the covariance *entries*, and classical transfer-current theory already does so. The new theorem performs an explicit orthogonal block decomposition into five classes, proves strict gap identities and evaluates the condition number for every k,n. It does not claim that computing entries from earlier formulas is itself new.

value.rationale: A complete all-dimensional spectral invariant of balanced multipartite spanning-tree base polytopes with sharply bounded condition number. Strict eigenmode order and special k=3 equality distinguish geometry not visible from marginal counts; useful as a benchmark for sampling and dispersion in graphic-matroid vertex spaces.
